name: print-social-blue-hiring-graphic-designer-web-banner-with-orange-armchair
title: Blue 'We're Hiring Graphic Designer' web banner with a man on an orange armchair
whatItIs: A wide blue web banner with cyan and white 'WE'RE HIRING GRAPHIC DESIGNER', a 'Responsibilities' list with chevrons on gradient bars, a smiling man with headphones on a laptop in an orange armchair at centre, and CV email, WhatsApp, a cyan 'Apply now' button and tagline on the right.
whatItMeans: Clear and balanced; a three-column banner gives role, person and action equal weight.
techniques: Arrange a banner in three columns: role, person, action.
Use an orange prop to pop against blue.
Put list items on fading gradient bars.

vocabulary.definition: A wide layout split into left, centre and right.
A strip fading from colour to transparent.
